item.title: To Understand The Solar Cycle, Notice How The Sun Sleeps
item.description: Astronomer Sandra Chapman has found a connection between the quiet period of one solar cycle and the active period of the next. Her data shows how a critical cutoff point is the key, but the real test will be the solar maximum of Cycle 26 in the 2030s.
